meta.title: What's new in Stormlog
meta.description: Stormlog 0.4.0 makes inference benchmarks reproducible: requests arrive on a schedule instead of waiting on the server, prompts share the cache only when you ask them to, and every command returns exit codes that CI jobs and agents can rely on.

updates.title: Send inference traffic on a schedule
updates.summary: stormlog infer profile can now send requests at a fixed rate, as a seeded Poisson process, in bursts, or replayed from a recording, instead of waiting for each answer. A slow server builds a queue, and the report shows it.
highlights: --arrival fixed-rate, poisson, burst or replay, with --max-in-flight and --overflow wait|drop
Latency measured from when each request was meant to leave, so time spent queued is not hidden
Each phase has a measured window and a drain deadline; requests left over are recorded as cancelled or dropped
Failures are split into timeout, rejected (HTTP 429/503), dropped and cancelled
updates.code:
stormlog infer profile \
  --base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 \
  --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct \
  --arrival poisson --rate 16 --duration 60 \
  --max-in-flight 64 --overflow wait \
  --output artifacts/poisson16.jsonl

stormlog infer analyze artifacts/poisson16.jsonl

updates.title: Control what prompts share, and record the cache state
updates.summary: Choose whether requests repeat one prompt, use a unique prompt each, or share a group prefix, so prefix-cache hits happen on purpose. Each run records the cache state it asked for, and a fingerprint of the traffic it sent.
highlights: --prompt-mode repeat, unique or shared-prefix, with --shared-prefix-ratio and --prefix-groups
--cache-state cold with --cache-reset-url clears the cache before each case (vLLM, SGLang)
Cache state is recorded as unverified, with the reason, until an engine adapter can confirm it
A workload digest lets you compare the same traffic across engines and runs
updates.code:
stormlog infer profile \
  --base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 \
  --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct \
  --input-tokens 2048 --requests 200 \
  --prompt-mode shared-prefix \
  --shared-prefix-ratio 0.75 --prefix-groups 4 \
  --cache-state cold \
  --cache-reset-url http://localhost:8000/reset_prefix_cache \
  --output artifacts/shared_prefix.jsonl

updates.title: Exit codes that mean one thing, and a report.json verdict
updates.summary: Every Stormlog command now returns a code from one fixed table, so a pipeline can tell a mistyped flag from memory risk or a failed budget. Each diagnose bundle also writes a versioned report.json with the verdict and its evidence.
highlights: 0 pass, 1 error, 2 usage, 3 findings, 4 gate failed, 5 invalid input, 130 interrupted
The same codes in gpumemprof, tfmemprof, jaxmemprof, stormlog infer and the benchmark harness
report.json pairs the verdict with the exit code and points each finding at its evidence
Breaking: diagnose exits 3 for memory risk (was 2); check scripts that matched the old numbers
updates.code:
from pathlib import Path

from stormlog.report import load_report

report = load_report(Path("diag/report.json"))
verdict = report["verdict"]
print(verdict["status"], verdict["exit_code"])

for finding in report["findings"]:
    print(finding["severity"], finding["title"])
